topic_zh: 函数与表达式：最后一行不加分号就是返回值
topic_en: Rust functions and expressions: the last line is the return value

xhs.title: Rust 函数没写 return 也能返回？
xhs.body:
第 4 课：函数与表达式
语句只做事，表达式会算出一个值
最后一行不加分号 → 它就是返回值
多加一个分号 → 返回空元组 ()，直接编译报错
考考你：fn five() -> i32 { 5; } 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

douyin.title: 一个分号，决定 Rust 函数返回什么
douyin.body:
最后一行不加分号就是返回值，加了分号值就没了。
考考你：fn five() -> i32 { 5; } 能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: No return keyword, still returns a value? In Rust, the last line without a semicolon is the return value. Quick quiz: fn five() -> i32 { 5; }  Does it compile? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: In Rust, one semicolon decides what a function returns
linkedin.body:
Statements do something; expressions evaluate to a value.
The last expression in a function body, with no semicolon, is the return value.
Add a semicolon and it becomes a statement that yields (), so the types no longer match.
Blocks work the same way, which is why if can be an expression too.
Quick quiz: fn five() -> i32 { 5; }  Does it compile? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: fn five() -> i32 { 5; } 能编译吗？
quiz.q_en: fn five() -> i32 { 5; }  Does it compile?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：不能。5 后面加了分号就变成语句，函数实际返回 ()，和 i32 对不上（mismatched types）。去掉分号就好了。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: no. The semicolon turns 5 into a statement, so the function returns (), not i32 (mismatched types). Drop the semicolon.
